name: ClipShield – YouTube Copyright Claim Remover
description: ClipShield is a high-performance application built for content creators (available for both Mobile devices and Windows PC) to download, edit, and repurpose YouTube videos without triggering copyright claims. It downloads HD streams, automatically identifies viral hooks, reframes videos to 9:16 vertical format, and applies 9 layers of advanced protection to make videos undetectable by YouTube Content ID.

features: Direct HD Video Downloader: Paste any YouTube URL and download HD streams instantly without IP bans
AI Viral Hook Finder: Scans long-form video to automatically identify the most viral, engaging clips
Smart 9:16 Reframing: Converts landscape videos (16:9) to vertical shorts (9:16) with face-centering
9-Layer Content ID Protection: Applies audio pitch, micro-speed, color grade, metadata spoofing, and crop filters
Super Fast Local Processing: Runs on your device (Mobile or Windows PC) with zero cloud upload delays
99.8% Claim-Free Success Rate: Proven track record avoiding copyright claims and channel strikes
sales_points: Mobile & Desktop Supported: Available for both Mobile users and Windows PC creators
100% Private & Offline: Operates locally on your device so your video assets remain completely private
Eliminates hours of manual editing and bypasses Content ID automatically
Flexible Pricing: Monthly License at Rs. 1,500 (negotiable down to Rs. 1,000 - 1,200) and Lifetime License at Rs. 3,500 (negotiable down to Rs. 2,800 - 3,000)
Lifetime updates included with Lifetime License with zero recurring fees
Includes 1 free trial video to test niche compatibility before paying
Instant activation via WhatsApp upon sharing your Hardware ID (HWID)
use_cases: Repurposing YouTube videos for Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels without copyright claims
Finding viral moments in podcasts, interviews, and long-form videos
Drama and movie recap channels avoiding automated Content ID takedowns
YouTube automation and faceless channel monetization

how_to_use:
1. Download the application & read setup guide from: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Y4dAxV-JO_scOKUW_2gXk5Mv4c59nQQvOBETKpCALF0/edit?usp=sharing (for PC) or https://docs.google.com/document/d/1dKX0N3qHkH0KqHyJw3_BD701n7aXsR-MwdOc_1jjB4U/edit (for Mobile).
2. Open ClipShield, go to Settings, and copy your Hardware ID (HWID).
3. Send your HWID to us on WhatsApp to activate your license.
4. Paste your license key into ClipShield and start repurposing copyright-free videos.
